Source: IPEDS 2023 (HD2023, DRVEF2023_RV, DRVHR2023_RV). Non-instructional staff = Total FTE staff − Instructional/Research/Public Service FTE. Ratio = total enrollment ÷ staff FTE in the selected category; a lower ratio means more staff per student. Institutions with zero or unreported FTE in the selected category are excluded from ranking.
